cues.text: In your dorm room, still in your school uniform, you sit down on the edge of the bed, shoulders slumped, head bowed.
You fall back across the bed, an arm over your forehead, and stare up.
You raise a hand; sparks glitter round your fingers and fade.
Your arm falls to the bed and your eyes close. You fall asleep on top of the covers.
Clock faces swirl over you as you sleep, until the hands meet at midnight.
